ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance on the distal lobes (~70%) contrasted against a low-intensity black central region and peripheral borders (~30%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions on both lateral lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a central triangular mass at the peduncle and extend along the trailing edge. Distinct circular low-intensity clusters are distributed throughout the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; central notch exhibits a sharp angle of approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5-20 pixels in amplitude, particularly prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular dark-ringed clusters (scars) across the white surface of both lobes, varying in diameter from 5 to 25 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, low-intensity linear streaks; notable diagonal mark crossing the mid-right lobe and multiple shorter vertical marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textured, high-intensity calcified clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pixel disruption caused by water spray and droplets along the lower boundary where the fluke meets the water surface.
